method.blind: Separate two four-second segments at 0 and 2 s. Match output ordering and polarity on their 2 s shared interval, decline if either absolute centered correlation is below 0.25, and linearly crossfade. Keep estimates with RMS at least 8 percent of the submission.
method.cutoffs: For each view use the AMI ordinary source-group maximum ranked second highest, bounded below by its highest measured isolated-background score. Use a strict cutoff and seal the values before ICSI scoring. An exact silent target is unassessed.
method.decision: On ICSI require at least two more useful locations on separate readers without a paired genuine location collision, at most one additional ordinary group and zero background flags to motivate new-source validation. Source labels are external diagnostic information.
method.inputs: Use the fixed minus-five-dB AMI and ICSI panels, including isolated backgrounds. Recover the exact target for diagnostic use only by integer subtraction of the paired isolated background.
method.phase: Convert the two estimated waveforms to complementary power-ratio masks in the 512-sample short-time transform with a 128-sample hop. Apply each mask to the submitted complex spectrum. Use the same stream ordering and activity rules as the direct estimates.
method.scoring: Use the existing Apache-2.0 one-second detector with its same 0.5 s grid and speech requirement independently on each estimated stream. Rank the largest response across streams and windows, with earliest ties. Reuse the parent mixed-window measurements.

method.inputs: Reuse all 96 frozen six-second mono deliveries at -5 dB and their two mixture-phase estimates. Subtract half of each estimate in turn. Require both estimates and both partially attenuated readings at the same one-second source window. Use the existing 50 percent speech requirement and 0.5 s hop.
method.points: For each rule use the second-highest AMI ordinary group maximum, bounded below by the maximum isolated background score. Use strict excess, choose one range, break ties at the earliest window, and freeze AMI points before ICSI inference. Compare fallback only where the app has no alert.
method.scores: Compare the highest response after either attenuation with a selective response that must be at least log(2) higher when attenuating the other estimate than when attenuating the supported estimate. Also test a rule that requires support from the submitted mix at the same interval, using the lower score.
method.source_check: At the known edit clock, compare the inferred stream against the benchmark foreground using the parent acoustic diagnostic. Source qualities never enter the score or thresholds.

method.calibrate: For each arm take the larger of the second-highest AMI ordinary foreground group maximum and the highest isolated AMI background maximum. Use a strict greater-than comparison and freeze both points before ICSI inference. Select at most one range per arm.
method.evaluation: Count candidate-only and any-range union with the current two-second check. Count useful ranges at 50% edit coverage and at least 0.30 intersection over union. Separately report unassessed files, new ordinary flags and new candidate locations that miss the edit.
method.inputs: Replay the native AMI development and ICSI transfer rosters. ICSI shares the foreground readers, edited words and generators with AMI, and uses different meeting captures.
method.scores: Measure native raw fake-vs-real log-odds on one- and two-second windows with half-second hops. Use the same speech activity model with at least half speech per window. Compare the one-second score alone and the smaller of that score and its centered two-second response, clamping the context at the file edges. Rank by largest value with earliest ties.

transfer.baseline: Replay the live short-review point. Apply the same frozen one-second mixed point. Count a matched collision on the untouched clip or either genuine splice. The room-only controls are separate excerpts and count as controls without a matched clock.
transfer.sources: All minus-five-dB clips plus the three isolated backgrounds from the fixed random-clock stock-voice panel. Use the same separator, waveform operations, and AMI cutoffs, without refitting.
